blind_spots.blind_spot: The site sells synthetic-world immersion; nothing in their language addresses the airworthiness and flight-clearance gauntlet between the F-16 award and fleet-wide fielding
blind_spots.operator_reality: Putting an AR headset with recording sensors and RF links inside a fleet F-16 requires a military flight clearance (SEEK EAGLE process), egress/ejection-safety qualification against the ACES II seat, and integration testing per tail configuration — a multi-year serial process that eats the STRATFI period of performance regardless of how fast the demo iterated
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Culture is prototype-speed ('concept to a flying prototype in only a few days'); flight clearance is the opposite tempo and lives with the government, so it never shows up in a startup's self-narrative until it becomes the schedule
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Don't be surprised when our technology goes from a concept to a flying prototype in only a few days.

blind_spots.blind_spot: No squadron-level sustainment story for a helmet-mounted hardware product
blind_spots.operator_reality: At a training squadron, ATARS competes for life-support-shop time with HGU-55 helmets and JHMCS: fit checks per pilot, spares and battery logistics, fault isolation by an E-5 aircrew flight equipment tech with 20 minutes of training — none of which appears in their language, which stops at the immersive experience
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team DNA is pilots, VFX artists, and game-engine engineers; testimonial energy is about what the pilot sees, and sustainment planning is invisible until the first squadron owns broken units
blind_spots.evidence_quote: We are warfighters, engineers and technologists. We are MBAs, visual artists, creatives and lawyers.

blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Data-driven... synthetic training worlds... at scale' presumes range connectivity and an accredited data pipeline they never describe
blind_spots.operator_reality: Multi-ship synthetic adversaries need low-latency datalinks across a training range and a security-accredited path for training data that mixes with real aircraft telemetry; range network accreditation and spectrum coordination are controlled by the government, and a cloud-synced training world degrades exactly like the 30fps crowd-detection case when the range link is intermittent
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Their proof points are single-aircraft and small-formation demos where a local link suffices; scale-and-frequency claims outrun the network and accreditation reality of operational training ranges
blind_spots.evidence_quote: fully immersive, data-driven, AI-enabled 3D synthetic training worlds that allow humans and machines to train together safely, frequently, and at scale in realistic threat environments

opener_hook: Red 6's F-16 ATARS award from ACC starts a flight-clearance and per-tail integration clock that runs at government speed while the STRATFI period of performance runs at calendar speed.
what_they_do: Builds ATARS, an augmented-reality system that puts synthetic adversaries and training environments into real fighter cockpits during live flight.
